name: lean-gate
description: A control panel and rule gate for how Claude works on your projects. It checks what Claude does and warns or blocks: model and effort on every agent, agent caps, release reviews, and project habits (state file, tests, PHPCS). Every setting is a button in a docked panel, with an Explain line for each. It carries token-saving project guides (plans, docs, file maps, memory, lessons, a shared agent board), ponytail, the WordPress performance audit, PHPCS with the WordPress standard and the ICM project layout, and registers, detects, starts and adopts projects.

context_limit.title: Context limit (tokens)
context_limit.description: Remind me to update the state file and start a new session once the conversation passes this many tokens.

remind_every.title: Remind again every (tokens)
remind_every.description: After the first reminder, remind again each time the conversation grows by this many tokens.

backup_docs.title: Always back up docs before editing
backup_docs.description: On: copy every doc to a dated backup folder before lean-gate edits it. Off: back up only when the project is not under version control.

session_drafts_dir.title: Session draft folder
session_drafts_dir.description: Where the end-of-session handoff drafts go, for example a folder in your Obsidian vault. Empty: the plugin data folder.

backup_dir.title: Backup folder
backup_dir.description: Where doc backups go, relative to the project folder.
